watch.text: Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren have missed 10 of 16 games; Caruso and Jaylin Williams are new outs and SGA (back/neck) is questionable at MIA on 11/22.
Giannis Antetokounmpo (right groin tendinitis, limited Saturday) is questionable vs OKC; he has played every game this season, so ratings assume him.
Stephen Curry (oblique tear) has missed 3 straight and is out vs BOS, estimated back about Dec 12; ratings still lean on the 13 games he played. Porzingis and Butler are also out.
Tatum (rest) and White (shoulder) sat the first night of the back-to-back at SAC on 11/21; Sunday status vs GS not posted yet. If both play, the SAC result understates Boston.
Caleb Wilson (hand, 4-6 weeks) is out since 11/12 and Norman Powell strained a hamstring on 11/21; the Bulls are without their two leading scorers vs DEN.
OG Anunoby (calf) and Karl-Anthony Towns (illness) missed 11/21 vs POR and are game-time decisions vs IND; Jordan Clarkson is out.
Pascal Siakam (hip) is questionable at NY, with Haliburton (9 games missed, 2+ more weeks) and McConnell already out.
P.J. Washington (30.9 mpg) missed 11/21 vs LAC (illness/shoulder); no status yet for the back-to-back at UTAH. Lively (foot) says he is close to his season debut.
CJ McCollum (calf) is out at least four weeks from 11/17 and Landale is out; Flemings (lumbar) is questionable vs DET.
Duncan Robinson (quad, since 11/17) and Jalen Duren (hamstring, 11 games) are out at ATL; Cade Cunningham (knee) is probable.
Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture, 11/11, at least a month) has missed 6 games and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL) 10; ratings still carry early games with them.
Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain, 4-6 weeks from 10/24) has missed 10 of 15 games; a return could come soon, check before tip.

401910030.summary: OKC is short-handed (Caruso and Jaylin Williams out, J. Williams and Holmgren still out) and SGA is questionable; that covers part of the 7-point gap, more if SGA sits.

reasons.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (low back contusion/neck strain) is questionable at MIA; Caruso and Jaylin Williams are out.
Giannis Antetokounmpo (groin tendinitis) is also questionable for Miami, which would push the other way.

swings.OKC: SGA was added as questionable (back/neck) and Caruso and Jaylin Williams were ruled out for 11/22; the market moved from Heat -2.5 to -4.5 (ClutchPoints, 11/21).
swings.MIA: Same game: the market moved toward Miami on OKC's injury list (SGA questionable, Caruso out), not on Miami news; Giannis is questionable too (NBC Sports, 11/21).

401910032.summary: Chicago is without its two leading scorers (Caleb Wilson since 11/12, Norman Powell's hamstring on 11/21), which covers the 3-point gap.

reasons.text: Norman Powell (mild right hamstring strain on 11/21) is out/questionable vs DEN and Jalen Smith (illness) is questionable.
Caleb Wilson (hand) is out 4-6 weeks from 11/12; the line moved from Nuggets -8.5 to -9.5.

401910035.summary: Golden State is without Stephen Curry (out since 11/12) and the market expects Tatum and White back after resting at SAC; Curry covers part of the 5.7-point gap.

reasons.text: Stephen Curry (oblique tear) is out vs BOS, ESPN estimates Dec 12; our ratings still carry his 13 games.
Tatum (rest) and White (shoulder) sat the first night of the back-to-back on 11/21; no Sunday status posted yet.

returning.text: Rested 11/21 at SAC (first night of back-to-back); expected back vs GS but not confirmed.

swings.BOS: At SAC on 11/21 Tatum and White sat, so the market was low on Boston; for GS the market prices them back after the rest night (Athlon, 11/21).
